March 13th, 2011

A friend group consisting of 5 teenage girls would disappear under suspicious circumstances, a burning car may suggest they had got into a freak accident, or else they may have been a subject of foul play, however, that was not the case. This is the pre-story to a series of multiple current affairs.

2011年3月13日
